sourcesNote: Story and missable flags are derived from the official trophy descriptions; PlayStation's own hidden list was not cross-checked from this machine.

trophies.guide: This one unlocks itself: earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then exploration and collectibles, then the activity grind — and treat this as the finish line rather than a task. Nothing here needs a separate method or a special trip.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its final objective — it is the first story mission, so it comes to you by playing normally. Follow the on-screen prompts; there is no way to skip past it and no alternate route. If a mission step stalls you, replay the mission from the pause menu and finish it cleanly.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Play the story in order and do not worry about side content yet — chapters unlock as you complete their missions. If you are unsure what remains, the pause menu's mission list shows your chapter progress.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Keep playing the story in order — side activities are optional at this stage and will not block the chapter. Exact mission order is not pinned down by the official description, so check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. By now the map is opening up, but the chapter still advances purely through its story missions. Do the story missions in the order they appear and the chapter will close on its own.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. This is the last numbered chapter, so expect its missions to be longer and harder than the early ones. Stock up on ammo and armour before the final mission and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final story mission — the gold trophy pops when the credits roll on it. Come prepared: bring your best weapons, full armour and snacks if the game offers them, and expect a long multi-stage mission. If you fail a stage, the mission checkpoints let you retry from the failed section rather than the start.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the story, so keep playing missions in order until it appears, then finish it to the end. If it does not appear yet, you are simply not far enough into the story — keep going.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually multi-part, so finish the setup steps first and then the heist itself. Bring a solid getaway vehicle and heavy weapons; the escape is normally the hardest part of a heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It arrives through the story, so play missions in order until it unlocks and then finish it. The exact mission trigger is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the story in order until the mission unlocks, then finish it to the end. If you get stuck on a combat section, use cover, switch to your strongest weapon and clear enemies before moving to the next objective.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Play the story in order until it unlocks; airport missions usually involve tight indoor combat, so bring close-range weapons and armour. Finish the mission to the end and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story in order until it unlocks, then finish it. The name suggests a large set-piece mission, so expect heavy combat and a long runtime — take your time and use checkpoints if a section goes wrong.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen. That means finishing the story, all side missions, all collectible sets, all activities and the checklist items the game counts toward completion. Treat this as the last gold before the platinum: work the roadmap in order and use the in-game completion percentage to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats all count toward the total. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so just drive fast and recklessly between missions and it climbs on its own. For the last stretch, find a long straight with ramps or jumps and repeat big jumps until the counter hits 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type the game offers at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation and whatever else the map offers. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start each type once. Open the map and look for activity icons you have never visited, then tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Visit a shooting range, learn each challenge's target pattern, and practise the ones you miss until the gold threshold is met. Use a steady aim, fire in controlled bursts and reload during lulls rather than mid-target. The exact number of challenges is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location on the map. Find each race marker, learn the course on a practice run, then race to win — cutting corners tightly and keeping speed through gates matters more than raw top speed. The exact number of locations is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins on the same one. Work through the race markers across the map, using a fast car or bike suited to each race type. If a race is hard, upgrade your vehicle first or retry it with a better-tuned ride.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing spot where Cal appears, accept the challenge and out-fish him — watch the line tension, reel steadily and do not let the fish snap the line. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game to its end. Visit an arcade, pick the game you are best at and play it through — you only need one full completion, not a high score. If a game is too hard, try a different machine; any completed arcade game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Work through Andy's mission strand in order — his missions unlock through the story and side content, so keep playing until his last one appears, then finish it. If his missions have not appeared yet, progress the main story further.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work through Kenton's mission strand in order until his last mission appears, then finish it. Boat missions usually need a fast boat and a steady hand at the wheel, so keep a good boat nearby before starting.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's mission strand in order until his last mission appears, then finish it. The name suggests a solo bike ride, so bring a fast bike and expect a long chase or escort section.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore — start each strand and follow it to its end, since only finished strands count. Explore the whole state and keep an eye out for stranger icons in towns and on back roads.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's mission strand in order until his last mission appears, then finish it. If his missions have not appeared yet, progress the main story further — character strands unlock as the story advances.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work through Tyrone's mission strand in order until his last mission appears, then finish it. The name suggests a driving or spinning set-piece, so bring a fast, durable vehicle before you start.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic locations marked on the map or found by exploring viewpoints — visit each one and use the meditate prompt. The exact number of spots is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Talk to Bret to start his hunting strand, follow his directions to the animal's territory, and take it down cleanly — a scoped rifle and a quiet approach help. The animal is unique, so do this before finishing Bret's strand; if the hunt goes wrong, reload a save from before the attempt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and out-of-the-way spots — so search thoroughly and tick off each set as you finish it. You only need 3 sets, not every card in the game, so focus on the sets you are closest to completing first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. The counter is cumulative, so tag a location whenever you pass one — the count builds up naturally if you WAiNK at every new place you visit. For the final stretch, sweep the map for untagged locations and work through them in one long drive.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying, sports and more, and each one you finish adds to the total. Pick the easiest challenges first — short races, simple shooting drills and quick stunts — and the counter will climb fast.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together and escape. Get the wanted level in a quiet area, then drive fast through back roads and alleys until the stars clear — do not let your partner get caught or killed. Partner missions are story-limited, so try this while a partner is available; if the attempt fails, reload a save from before it.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the streak breaks if the cops drop you. Pick three shops close together, rob each quickly and drive straight to the next without stopping. If the wanted level clears, the streak resets, so start the run over; keep a fast getaway car ready.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — driving a new vehicle type for the first time adds it to the count. The counter climbs naturally as you play, since the game is full of different cars, bikes, boats and aircraft. For the last few, visit vehicle-heavy areas like airports, docks and car meets to find types you have never driven.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Start Combat Focus in a fight with a group of enemies close together, then sweep through them quickly before the effect ends. A crowded shootout or a mission with clustered enemies is the best place to try it; if you only get 4, retry the fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport — get a plane off the ground without going through the normal departure routine. Steal a plane from the airport, get to the runway and take off before the authorities stop you. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This one involves Rhino tanks — the description is a joke, not a checklist, so the exact requirement is not pinned down by the official description. The sensible method is to steal or drive a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it until the trophy pops. Check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Plan the robbery first: case the store, enter quietly, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — reload a save from before the robbery and try a quieter approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault needs a plan: get in, crack or blow the vault, grab the cash and escape before the police close in. Use a fast getaway vehicle and a route you have scouted in advance; escaping cleanly is what counts, not how fast you crack the vault.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, block it or force it to stop, grab the cash inside and get away before the police arrive. A heavy vehicle to ram the truck and a fast car to escape in make the job much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail across the whole state — every named district, town and stretch of wilderness counts. Use the map to spot unexplored regions and sweep them systematically; the trophy pops once the last area registers. The exact number of areas is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operation — look for their territory markers and activity icons — raid it and get out with the goods. Work gang by gang and keep a note of which ones you have already hit so none is missed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy should pop once the drink and the location register together. The exact spot is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a vehicle showroom, then smash straight back out through the front window — the classic GTA exit. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed inside if you can, and drive through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Find the alley, start a game and follow through a full game — the trophy is about playing it properly, not about a high score. If the alley does not show on the map yet, progress the story until it unlocks.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a partnership with mass appeal. The sensible reading is a partner activity that draws a crowd or goes public, such as a shared stunt or a high-profile job with your partner. The exact requirement is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. This trophy tracks the decisions you make across the story, so keep playing and choosing; it should pop once you have made enough meaningful choices. Choices are permanent in a playthrough, so think before you pick — and if you want every outcome, a second playthrough is the honest way to see the other side.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something — the name says second time is the charm. The honest reading is that you must fail an attempt at a challenge or mission first, then succeed on the retry. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description reads like a random or hidden event. Explore odd corners of Leonida at night, visit remote spots and keep an eye out for anything out of place. The exact event is not pinned down by the official description — check the sources linked below once the game is out; this guide will be updated.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass and land the hit. Pick a quiet street so you can line the pass up without traffic in the way.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists, then pass them to your contacts to clean the money — each laundered batch adds to the total. Keep robbing and laundering steadily; the counter is cumulative, so it climbs over the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy weapons, ammo, clothes, cars and upgrades — every dollar spent in a shop counts toward the total. The counter is cumulative, so just keep buying what you need as you play and it will fill up on its own.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property available in Leonida. Garages appear on the map as property icons — visit each one and buy it when you have the cash. Save up between purchases; property prices add up, so do this after you have a steady income from missions and heists.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you own or have just acquired, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — every registered vehicle adds to the count. You only need 10, so register the first ten vehicles you drive regularly and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
